user: How long does the investigation usually take?
answer:
I couldn't find a timeframe for how long a dispute investigation takes. The knowledge base has no duration or resolution-time information for disputes, so I can't give you a figure.

What I can confirm from the documentation:
- You will receive a notification on every change in the dispute's status. The notification names the new status but not the internal reason for any decision.
- You can withdraw the dispute at any time before it is resolved. Withdrawal is final for that transaction and reason code.

For the expected timeline, I can escalate to a human agent who can give you a realistic estimate before you decide. Or, if you're ready, I can file the dispute now. Please tell me which you prefer. I won't file anything until you explicitly confirm.

fragments.text:
Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Glossary
## Provisional credit
A temporary refund applied while a dispute is reviewed; reversed if the dispute
is declined.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
